description: Research bundle: takes a query and returns up to 10 deduplicated, rendered web sources as one token-budgeted Markdown bundle (about 8,000 tokens), one source per domain. Combines web search with rendered-page fetching in a single call. Needs at least 3 fetched sources; the response reports sources_requested and sources_returned. Optional region=tw selects a Taiwan, Traditional Chinese lane. Costs $0.031 per call via x402 -- only charged when a real search actually runs. A vague query pauses and asks for clarification at no cost; a search that can't find enough sources also pauses at no cost, suggesting a broadened query you can choose to run (which then does cost $0.031).

region.description: Optional. Set to 'tw' for Traditional Chinese / Taiwan-region sources.

name: tariffmonkee-research
